mesnalty.translation: n. [律]中间领主的封地(或身份)

mesne.definition:
a. Middle; intervening; as, a mesne lord, that is, a lord who
   holds land of a superior, but grants a part of it to another person, in
   which case he is a tenant to the superior, but lord or superior to the
   second grantee, and hence is called the mesne lord.
mesne.translation:
a. 中的, 中间的
[法] 中间程序的, 中间的

mesne landlord.translation: [法] 二房东, 中间业主

mesne process.translation: [法] 中间诉讼阶段, 中间传票, 中间状令

mesnili chilomastix.translation: [医] 迈[斯尼耳]氏唇鞭毛虫
